notes: #1–#4 are two impressions of the same Alekseyev view (1808 and 1809) plus cropped copies; #2 has the brightest color. All are small (about 1300 px wide). The engraving shows the Glory Monument, which was only unveiled in 1811. #6 (1899) is a similar rooftop view to #7; #5 is a postcard with a wrong caption. #9 (Holy Cross Monastery, 2013) is an alternative P6 landmark view but hazy.
